sources.title: Oliver Kell official Cycle of Price Action framework
sources.summary: The public framework treats EMA Crossback as a pullback within continuation and Wedge Drop as a downtrend warning. It does not publish exact moving-average periods or a complete numeric exit condition.

sources.title: Mark Minervini official strategy
sources.summary: The public strategy page explains the historical development of SEPA and low-risk entries, without an executable post-entry failure threshold or timed exit rule.

sources.title: Mark Minervini official biography
sources.summary: The biography describes strict risk control but does not define a new quantitative lifecycle component. Reported 2021 competition performance is checked against organizer standings separately.
